exemplars.paper_id: FOOL_ Addressing the Downlink Bottleneck in Satellite Computing with Neural Feature Compression
exemplars.key_insight: 用浅层特征而非图像重建作失真目标,可保留足够信息供任意下游任务同时获高压缩率
exemplars.method_signature: FOOL神经特征压缩:Profiler+TCR/s度量+并发执行+特征空间重建

exemplars.paper_id: Resource-efficient In-orbit Detection of Earth Objects
exemplars.key_insight: 利用置信度阈值在星上处理与下行之间动态分配；存在最优分块大小平衡精度与计算开销
exemplars.method_signature: 星地协同+自适应图像分块+聚类去重+带宽感知下行节流

exemplars.key_insight: 首次对公共边缘平台进行综合测量,揭示关键问题并开源数据集以推动研究社区
exemplars.method_signature: 测量驱动问题发现 + 算法优化 + 标准实现 + 前瞻探索 四阶段研究

exemplars.paper_id: FedMoE_ Personalized Federated Learning via Heterogeneous Mixture of Experts
exemplars.key_insight: MoE的稀疏激活使专家参数空间解耦，允许按需共享最相关参数——不同客户激活不同专家即可实现个性化
exemplars.method_signature: 两阶段：Stage1用激活概率启发式搜索初始化子模型；Stage2联邦训练+模块聚合+动态专家推荐

exemplars.paper_id: Federated Few-Shot Learning for Mobile NLP
exemplars.key_insight: 模型弱时仅选高置信伪标签，随着模型变强逐步加速注入，通过配置空间<freq, n, k>动态调节训练节奏
exemplars.method_signature: FeS系统含课程步调、表示多样性过滤、层深与容量联合规划三大设计

exemplars.paper_id: Hierarchical Federated Learning through LAN-WAN Orchestration
exemplars.key_insight: LAN abundant bandwidth (tens of Mbps) can be exploited for frequent local aggregation, reducing reliance on expensive constrained WAN
exemplars.method_signature: LanFL: two-level aggregation hierarchy with P2P intra-LAN topology and dynamic device selection for heterogeneous LAN
